                         f"this view again)\\n" + _strip_refs(view.split("\\n\\n", 1)[-1])[:3000])
            names.append(path)
            continue
        opened.add(target)
        texts.append(_strip_refs(view.split("\\n\\n", 1)[-1])[:8000])
        names.append(path)

    def was_opened(text: str) -> bool:
        return not text.startswith(("not opened", "did not open", "already opened"))

    head, tail = _common_edges([t for t in texts if was_opened(t)])
    out, more = [], {}
    for i, (name, text) in enumerate(zip(names, texts)):
        if was_opened(text):
            for link in _LINK.findall(text):
                target = urljoin(session.page.url, link)
                if urlparse(target).netloc == urlparse(session.site["url"]).netloc and target not in opened:
                    more.setdefault(link, None)
        if i and was_opened(text) and (head or tail):
            lines = text.splitlines()
            text = "\\n".join(lines[head:len(lines) - tail]) + "\\n[page frame as in the first page]"
        out.append(f"=== {name}\\n{text}")
    if more:
        out.append("Links on these views you have not opened yet: " + " ".join(list(more)[:40]))
    return "\\n\\n".join(out)

class Erp:
    """
    The ERP website: one signed-in context and a few reused tabs, so requirements and materials run in parallel.

    The ERP drops its session after some idle minutes and when several tabs sign in at once. Sign-ins are therefore
    serialised over the tabs, and a tab that lands somewhere other than the view it asked for (a sign-in, an entry
    gate) gets one model worker past the gate (`recover`, one tab at a time) and opens its view again.
    """

    def __init__(self, site: dict, context: BrowserContext, trace: Trace, deadline: float | None = None):
        self.site, self.context, self.trace, self.deadline = site, context, trace, deadline
        self.ready: asyncio.Task | None = None
        self.materials: dict[str, asyncio.Task] = {}
        self.tasks: dict[str, asyncio.Task] = {}
        # a few tabs at once: every tab is one more page load on a site that slows down under load
        self.tabs = asyncio.Semaphore(int(os.environ.get("ERP_TABS", "6")))
        self.idle_pages: list[Page] = []  # open tabs a finished worker left, reused instead of a fresh start
        self.signin = asyncio.Lock()  # one sign-in at a time
        self.signins = 0
        self.gate = asyncio.Lock()  # one tab gets past an entry gate at a time
        self.passes = 0  # gates passed; a tab that waited for another one's pass just opens its view again
        self.started_at: float | None = None

    def left(self) -> float:
        return float("inf") if self.deadline is None else self.deadline - time.monotonic()

    def warm_up(self) -> asyncio.Task:
        """Sign in and get past entry gates once (a model handles gates the helpers cannot), e.g. while the
        specification is still being read."""
        if self.ready is None:
            self.ready = asyncio.create_task(self._warm_up())
        return self.ready

    async def _warm_up(self) -> None:
        try:
            session = await self._tab("start")
        except Exception as error:  # the workers' own tabs try again
            self.trace.event("erp", "warm_up_failed", error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:160]}")
            return
        try:
            await self._pass_gate(session)
        finally:
            await self._close(session)

    async def _pass_gate(self, session: SiteSession) -> None:
        await run_worker(session, GATE_GOAL, Ready, deadline=self._until(0), max_steps=8,
                         **_worker_kwargs(notes=False, grounded=False))
        self.passes += 1

    async def recover(self, session: SiteSession) -> None:
        """The tab did not reach its view (session dropped, entry gate): get past the gate once for all tabs."""
        passes = self.passes
        async with self.gate:
            if self.passes != passes:  # another tab passed the gate while this one waited
                return
            self.trace.event(session.name, "erp_recover", url=session.page.url)
            await self._pass_gate(session)

    def _until(self, reserve: float) -> float | None:
        return None if self.deadline is None else self.deadline - reserve

    def _guard_login(self, session: SiteSession) -> None:
        """Sign-ins one tab at a time; a tab that waited while another signed in first reloads, since the shared
        context may already be signed in again."""
        login = session._login

        async def serialised(page: Page) -> bool:
            if not await page.locator("input[type=password]:visible").count():
                return False
            signins = self.signins
            async with self.signin:
                if self.signins != signins:
                    try:
                        await page.reload(wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=30000)
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                    if not await page.locator("input[type=password]:visible").count():
                        session.events.append("another tab signed in; reloaded")
                        return True
                done = await login(page)
                if done:
                    self.signins += 1
                    await asyncio.sleep(1.0)  # let the sign-in land before the next tab acts
                return done

        session._login = serialised  # type: ignore[method-assign]

    async def _tab(self, tag: str, url: str | None = None) -> SiteSession:
        """A tab in the shared context (a reused one when a finished worker left it); `tag` names it in the
        trace. With `url`, the tab opens that link target."""
        session = SiteSession({**self.site, "siteId": f"{self.site['siteId']}:{tag}"}, self.context, self.trace)
        self._guard_login(session)
        session.recover = lambda: self.recover(session)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
        page = None
        while self.idle_pages and page is None:
            candidate = self.idle_pages.pop()
            page = None if candidate.is_closed() else candidate
        if page is not None:
            session.scripted = True  # the context already has the popup closer
            session._watch(page)
            if url is None:
                await session._goto(self.site["url"])
                await session.look()
        else:
            await session.start()
        if url:
            await self.open(session, url)
        return session

    async def open(self, session: SiteSession, url: str) -> bool:
        """Open a link target a model reported, with the same rule as the goto tool: only on this website. A tab
        that lands elsewhere (sign-in, entry gate) recovers once and opens it again."""
        target = on_site(self.site, url)
        if target is None:
            self.trace.event(session.name, "link_refused", url=url)
            return False
        for attempt in range(2):
            async with session.lock:
                await session._goto(target)
            await session.look()
            landed, wanted = urlparse(session.page.url), urlparse(target)
            if (landed.path, landed.query) == (wanted.path, wanted.query):
                session.__dict__.setdefault("opened", set()).add(target)
                return True
            if not attempt:
                await self.recover(session)
        return False

    async def _close(self, session: SiteSession) -> None:
        """Hand the worker's tab back for reuse (popups it opened are closed)."""
        kept = False
        for page in session.pages:
            try:
                page.remove_listener("dialog", session._on_dialog)
                page.remove_listener("popup", session._on_popup)
            except Exception:
                pass
            if not kept and not page.is_closed() and len(self.idle_pages) < 8:
                self.idle_pages.append(page)
                kept = True
                continue
            try:
                await page.close()
            except Exception:  # already gone
                continue

    async def _worker_tab(self, tag: str, url: str | None = None) -> SiteSession | None:
        try:  # a tab that does not open costs this attempt, not the research
            return await self._tab(tag, url)
        except Exception as error:
            self.trace.event("erp", "tab_failed", tag=tag, error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:160]}")
            return None

    async def requirement(self, req: EffectiveRequirement) -> RequirementResearch:
        out = RequirementResearch(requirement_id=req.requirement_id)
        await self.warm_up()
        report = None
        for attempt in range(2):  # retry once: the ERP sometimes drops the session mid-search
            if self.left() < MATERIAL_SECONDS:
                break
            async with self.tabs:
                session = await self._worker_tab(req.requirement_id if not attempt else f"{req.requirement_id}+")
                if session is None:
                    continue
                try:
                    report, _ = await run_worker(
                        session, SEARCH_GOAL.format(group=req.catalog_group, want=_want(req)), SearchReport,
                        deadline=self._until(MATERIAL_SECONDS), max_steps=steps(self._until(MATERIAL_SECONDS), 6, 16),
                        tools=(site_tools.search, site_tools.collect), **_worker_kwargs(notes=False))
                finally:
                    await self._close(session)
            if report is not None:
                break
        if report is None:
            out.problems.append("search worker returned no result")
            return out
        out.search_term = report.search_term
        out.candidates = [Candidate(material_number=c.material_number.strip(), link=c.link.strip(),
                                    bore=_num(c.bore), stroke=_num(c.stroke), pressure=_num(c.pressure),
                                    mounting=c.mounting, certification=c.certification)
                          for c in report.candidates]
        # every hit of the model's search is inspected (the rules cap a usable search at 20 hits); which one fits is
        # the model's choice below, once the details are known
        out.inspected = list(dict.fromkeys(c.material_number for c in out.candidates))[:MAX_INSPECT]
        if len(out.candidates) > MAX_INSPECT:
            out.problems.append(f"{len(out.candidates)} hits, inspected the first {MAX_INSPECT}")
        links = {c.material_number: c.link for c in out.candidates}
        tasks = [self.material(number, links.get(number, "")) for number in out.inspected]
        # materials finish before the deadline (their workers stop early enough for the reader); whatever is still
        # open then is left out, and the choice is made over the records that are complete
        done, _ = await asyncio.wait(tasks, timeout=max(1.0, self.left() - CHOOSE_SECONDS)) if tasks else (set(), set())
        materials = {}
        for task in tasks:
            if task in done and not task.cancelled() and task.exception() is None and task.result() is not None:
                materials[task.result().material_number] = task.result()
        if len(materials) < len(out.inspected):
            out.problems.append(f"{len(out.inspected) - len(materials)} of {len(out.inspected)} materials not read")
        try:
            out.selected, problems = await asyncio.wait_for(choose_material(req, out, materials, self.trace),
                                                            max(1.0, self.left() - 2))
        except asyncio.TimeoutError:
            out.selected, problems = None, [f"{req.requirement_id}: no choice before the research deadline"]
        out.problems += problems
        return out

    def material(self, number: str, link: str = "") -> asyncio.Task:
        """One detail worker per material, shared when several requirements inspect the same one."""
        if number not in self.materials:
            self.materials[number] = asyncio.create_task(self._material(number, link))
        return self.materials[number]

    async def _material(self, number: str, link: str) -> MaterialRecord | None:
        views: dict[str, str] = {}
        record = None
        focus = ""
        name = f"{self.site['siteId']}:{number}"
        for attempt in range(2):  # a second pass, keeping what was read, when facts are missing
            if self.left() < (MATERIAL_SECONDS if not attempt else MATERIAL_SECONDS + 60):
                break  # a second pass only with time for it; the first record stays either way
            coverage = None
            async with self.tabs:
                session = await self._worker_tab(number if not attempt else f"{number}+", link or None)
                if session is None:
                    continue
                name = session.name
                try:
                    _keep_views(session, views)
                    if link and session.view:  # the record view opened in _tab, kept for the reader too
                        views[session.page.url] = _strip_refs(session.view)
                    until = self._until(READ_SECONDS)
                    coverage, _ = await run_worker(session, DETAIL_GOAL.format(material=number, focus=focus),
                                                   Coverage, deadline=until, max_steps=steps(until, 4, 14),
                                                   tools=(open_pages,), **_worker_kwargs(notes=False, grounded=False))
                finally:
                    await self._close(session)
            corpus = _corpus(views)
            self.trace.event(name, "material_read", views=len(views), chars=len(corpus),
                             not_found=coverage.not_found if coverage else "worker stopped")
            try:
                seen = await asyncio.wait_for(_read_material(number, corpus, self.trace, name),
                                              max(5.0, self.left() - CHOOSE_SECONDS))
            except Exception as error:
                self.trace.event(name, "material_failed", error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:200]}")
                continue
            record = _material_record(seen)
            missing = incomplete(record)
            if not missing:
                break
            record.problems.append(f"missing after pass {attempt + 1}: {', '.join(missing)}")
            focus = f"\nStill missing from the views read so far: {', '.join(missing)}. Open the views for these."
        if record is not None and record.material_number != number:
            record.problems.append(f"reader reported material {record.material_number} for {number}")
        return record

    def start(self, req: EffectiveRequirement) -> asyncio.Task:
        """Research one requirement in the background (e.g. as soon as the specification yields it)."""
        if self.started_at is None:
            self.started_at = time.monotonic()
        if req.requirement_id not in self.tasks:
            self.tasks[req.requirement_id] = asyncio.create_task(self.requirement(req))
        return self.tasks[req.requirement_id]

    async def collect(self) -> ErpResearch:
        """Wait for every started requirement and the materials they inspect (each ends by the deadline)."""
        results = []
        for k in sorted(self.tasks, key=calc.position_key):
            try:
                results.append(await self.tasks[k])
            except Exception as error:  # one failed requirement must not cost the others
                results.append(RequirementResearch(requirement_id=k, problems=[
                    f"research failed: {type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:160]}"]))
        return ErpResearch(requirements=results, materials=self.records(),
                           seconds=round(time.monotonic() - (self.started_at or time.monotonic()), 1))

    def records(self) -> dict[str, MaterialRecord]:
        """Every material record finished so far."""
        out = {}
        for number, task in self.materials.items():
            if task.done() and not task.cancelled() and task.exception() is None and task.result() is not None:
                out[number] = task.result()
            elif task.done() and not task.cancelled() and task.exception() is not None:
                self.trace.event("erp", "material_failed", material=number, error=type(task.exception()).__name__)
        return out

    async def research(self, requirements: list[EffectiveRequirement]) -> ErpResearch:
        for req in requirements:
            self.start(req)
        return await self.collect()


class MaterialChoice(BaseModel):
    material_number: str = Field(description="The chosen material number, or '' if none of them qualifies")
    why: str = Field(description="In a few words")


CHOOSE_MATERIAL = """\
You choose the ERP material for one tender requirement. Only an active (released) material qualifies, and its
bore, stroke, pressure, mounting and certification must all equal the requirement exactly (numbers as numbers;
no certification required means the material must name none). Blocked materials never qualify. If none
qualifies, answer ''."""

# The choice is a short decision over records already read, and `evidence.check_choice` sends a wrong one back with
# the reason, so it runs thinking off with a short timeout (RESEARCH_CHOOSE_THINKING=1 turns thinking on).
CHOOSE_THINKING = os.environ.get("RESEARCH_CHOOSE_THINKING", "0") == "1"


def _describe(number: str, record: MaterialRecord, research: RequirementResearch) -> str:
    attrs = merged_attributes(record, research)
    shown = ", ".join(f"{k} {attrs[k]}" for k in ("bore", "stroke", "pressure", "mounting", "certification")
                      if k in attrs)
    return f"- {number}: status {record.status}, active={record.active}; {shown}"


async def choose_material(req: EffectiveRequirement, research: RequirementResearch,
                          materials: dict[str, MaterialRecord], trace: Trace | None = None
                          ) -> tuple[str | None, list[str]]:
    """The model picks the material from the inspected candidates; `evidence.check_choice` validates the exact
    match and status and sends a wrong choice back with the reason."""
    if req.stroke is None:
        return None, [f"{req.requirement_id}: stroke pending ({'; '.join(req.pending)})"]
    if not materials:
        return None, [f"{req.requirement_id}: no material could be inspected"]
    agent = Agent(llm.model(), output_type=MaterialChoice, instructions=CHOOSE_MATERIAL,
                  model_settings=llm.settings(CHOOSE_THINKING, timeout=llm.env_seconds("LLM_CHOOSE_TIMEOUT", 30.0)),
                  retries=3)

    @agent.output_validator

class Erp:
    """
    The ERP website: one signed-in context and a few reused tabs, so requirements and materials run in parallel.

    The ERP drops its session after some idle minutes and when several tabs sign in at once. Sign-ins are therefore
    serialised over the tabs, and a tab that lands somewhere other than the view it asked for (a sign-in, an entry
    gate) gets one model worker past the gate (`recover`, one tab at a time) and opens its view again.
    """

    def __init__(self, site: dict, context: BrowserContext, trace: Trace, deadline: float | None = None):
        self.site, self.context, self.trace, self.deadline = site, context, trace, deadline
        self.ready: asyncio.Task | None = None
        self.materials: dict[str, asyncio.Task] = {}
        self.tasks: dict[str, asyncio.Task] = {}
        # a few tabs at once: every tab is one more page load on a site that slows down under load
        self.tabs = asyncio.Semaphore(int(os.environ.get("ERP_TABS", "6")))
        self.idle_pages: list[Page] = []  # open tabs a finished worker left, reused instead of a fresh start
        self.signin = asyncio.Lock()  # one sign-in at a time
        self.signins = 0
        self.gate = asyncio.Lock()  # one tab gets past an entry gate at a time
        self.passes = 0  # gates passed; a tab that waited for another one's pass just opens its view again
        self.started_at: float | None = None

    def left(self) -> float:
        return float("inf") if self.deadline is None else self.deadline - time.monotonic()

    def warm_up(self) -> asyncio.Task:
        """Sign in and get past entry gates once (a model handles gates the helpers cannot), e.g. while the
        specification is still being read."""
        if self.ready is None:
            self.ready = asyncio.create_task(self._warm_up())
        return self.ready

    async def _warm_up(self) -> None:
        try:
            session = await self._tab("start")
        except Exception as error:  # the workers' own tabs try again
            self.trace.event("erp", "warm_up_failed", error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:160]}")
            return
        try:
            await self._pass_gate(session)
        finally:
            await self._close(session)

    async def _pass_gate(self, session: SiteSession) -> None:
        await run_worker(session, GATE_GOAL, Ready, deadline=self._until(0), max_steps=8,
                         **_worker_kwargs(notes=False, grounded=False))
        self.passes += 1

    async def recover(self, session: SiteSession) -> None:
        """The tab did not reach its view (session dropped, entry gate): get past the gate once for all tabs."""
        passes = self.passes
        async with self.gate:
            if self.passes != passes:  # another tab passed the gate while this one waited
                return
            self.trace.event(session.name, "erp_recover", url=session.page.url)
            await self._pass_gate(session)

    def _until(self, reserve: float) -> float | None:
        return None if self.deadline is None else self.deadline - reserve

    def _guard_login(self, session: SiteSession) -> None:
        """Sign-ins one tab at a time; a tab that waited while another signed in first reloads, since the shared
        context may already be signed in again."""
        login = session._login

        async def serialised(page: Page) -> bool:
            if not await page.locator("input[type=password]:visible").count():
                return False
            signins = self.signins
            async with self.signin:
                if self.signins != signins:
                    try:
                        await page.reload(wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=30000)
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                    if not await page.locator("input[type=password]:visible").count():
                        session.events.append("another tab signed in; reloaded")
                        return True
                done = await login(page)
                if done:
                    self.signins += 1
                    await asyncio.sleep(1.0)  # let the sign-in land before the next tab acts
                return done

        session._login = serialised  # type: ignore[method-assign]

    async def _tab(self, tag: str, url: str | None = None) -> SiteSession:
        """A tab in the shared context (a reused one when a finished worker left it); `tag` names it in the
        trace. With `url`, the tab opens that link target."""
        session = SiteSession({**self.site, "siteId": f"{self.site['siteId']}:{tag}"}, self.context, self.trace)
        self._guard_login(session)
        session.recover = lambda: self.recover(session)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
        page = None
        while self.idle_pages and page is None:
            candidate = self.idle_pages.pop()
            page = None if candidate.is_closed() else candidate
        if page is not None:
            session.scripted = True  # the context already has the popup closer
            session._watch(page)
            if url is None:
                await session._goto(self.site["url"])
                await session.look()
        else:
            await session.start()
        if url:
            await self.open(session, url)
        return session

    async def open(self, session: SiteSession, url: str) -> bool:
        """Open a link target a model reported, with the same rule as the goto tool: only on this website. A tab
        that lands elsewhere (sign-in, entry gate) recovers once and opens it again."""
        target = on_site(self.site, url)
        if target is None:
            self.trace.event(session.name, "link_refused", url=url)
            return False
        for attempt in range(2):
            async with session.lock:
                await session._goto(target)
            await session.look()
            landed, wanted = urlparse(session.page.url), urlparse(target)
            if (landed.path, landed.query) == (wanted.path, wanted.query):
                session.__dict__.setdefault("opened", set()).add(target)
                return True
            if not attempt:
                await self.recover(session)
        return False

    async def _close(self, session: SiteSession) -> None:
        """Hand the worker's tab back for reuse (popups it opened are closed)."""
        kept = False
        for page in session.pages:
            try:
                page.remove_listener("dialog", session._on_dialog)
                page.remove_listener("popup", session._on_popup)
            except Exception:
                pass
            if not kept and not page.is_closed() and len(self.idle_pages) < 8:
                self.idle_pages.append(page)
                kept = True
                continue
            try:
                await page.close()
            except Exception:  # already gone
                continue

    async def _worker_tab(self, tag: str, url: str | None = None) -> SiteSession | None:
        try:  # a tab that does not open costs this attempt, not the research
            return await self._tab(tag, url)
        except Exception as error:
            self.trace.event("erp", "tab_failed", tag=tag, error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:160]}")
            return None

    async def requirement(self, req: EffectiveRequirement) -> RequirementResearch:
        out = RequirementResearch(requirement_id=req.requirement_id)
        await self.warm_up()
        report = None
        for attempt in range(2):  # retry once: the ERP sometimes drops the session mid-search
            if self.left() < MATERIAL_SECONDS:
                break
            async with self.tabs:
                session = await self._worker_tab(req.requirement_id if not attempt else f"{req.requirement_id}+")
                if session is None:
                    continue
                try:
                    report, _ = await run_worker(
                        session, SEARCH_GOAL.format(group=req.catalog_group, want=_want(req)), SearchReport,
                        deadline=self._until(MATERIAL_SECONDS), max_steps=steps(self._until(MATERIAL_SECONDS), 6, 16),
                        tools=(site_tools.search, site_tools.collect), **_worker_kwargs(notes=False))
                finally:
                    await self._close(session)
            if report is not None:
                break
        if report is None:
            out.problems.append("search worker returned no result")
            return out
        out.search_term = report.search_term
        out.candidates = [Candidate(material_number=c.material_number.strip(), link=c.link.strip(),
                                    bore=_num(c.bore), stroke=_num(c.stroke), pressure=_num(c.pressure),
                                    mounting=c.mounting, certification=c.certification)
                          for c in report.candidates]
        # every hit of the model's search is inspected (the rules cap a usable search at 20 hits); which one fits is
        # the model's choice below, once the details are known
        out.inspected = list(dict.fromkeys(c.material_number for c in out.candidates))[:MAX_INSPECT]
        if len(out.candidates) > MAX_INSPECT:
            out.problems.append(f"{len(out.candidates)} hits, inspected the first {MAX_INSPECT}")
        links = {c.material_number: c.link for c in out.candidates}
        tasks = [self.material(number, links.get(number, "")) for number in out.inspected]
        # materials finish before the deadline (their workers stop early enough for the reader); whatever is still
        # open then is left out, and the choice is made over the records that are complete
        done, _ = await asyncio.wait(tasks, timeout=max(1.0, self.left() - CHOOSE_SECONDS)) if tasks else (set(), set())
        materials = {}
        for task in tasks:
            if task in done and not task.cancelled() and task.exception() is None and task.result() is not None:
                materials[task.result().material_number] = task.result()
        if len(materials) < len(out.inspected):
            out.problems.append(f"{len(out.inspected) - len(materials)} of {len(out.inspected)} materials not read")
        try:
            out.selected, problems = await asyncio.wait_for(choose_material(req, out, materials, self.trace),
                                                            max(1.0, self.left() - 2))
        except asyncio.TimeoutError:
            out.selected, problems = None, [f"{req.requirement_id}: no choice before the research deadline"]
        out.problems += problems
        return out

    def material(self, number: str, link: str = "") -> asyncio.Task:
        """One detail worker per material, shared when several requirements inspect the same one."""
        if number not in self.materials:
            self.materials[number] = asyncio.create_task(self._material(number, link))
        return self.materials[number]

    async def _material(self, number: str, link: str) -> MaterialRecord | None:
        views: dict[str, str] = {}
        record = None
        focus = ""
        name = f"{self.site['siteId']}:{number}"
        for attempt in range(2):  # a second pass, keeping what was read, when facts are missing
            if self.left() < (MATERIAL_SECONDS if not attempt else MATERIAL_SECONDS + 60):
                break  # a second pass only with time for it; the first record stays either way
            coverage = None
            async with self.tabs:
                session = await self._worker_tab(number if not attempt else f"{number}+", link or None)
                if session is None:
                    continue
                name = session.name
                try:
                    _keep_views(session, views)
                    if link and session.view:  # the record view opened in _tab, kept for the reader too
                        views[session.page.url] = _strip_refs(session.view)
                    until = self._until(READ_SECONDS)
                    coverage, _ = await run_worker(session, DETAIL_GOAL.format(material=number, focus=focus),
                                                   Coverage, deadline=until, max_steps=steps(until, 4, 14),
                                                   tools=(open_pages,), **_worker_kwargs(notes=False, grounded=False))
                finally:
                    await self._close(session)
            corpus = _corpus(views)
            self.trace.event(name, "material_read", views=len(views), chars=len(corpus),
                             not_found=coverage.not_found if coverage else "worker stopped")
            try:
                seen = await asyncio.wait_for(_read_material(number, corpus, self.trace, name),
                                              max(5.0, self.left() - CHOOSE_SECONDS))
            except Exception as error:
                self.trace.event(name, "material_failed", error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:200]}")
                continue
            record = _material_record(seen)
            missing = incomplete(record)
            if not missing:
                break
            record.problems.append(f"missing after pass {attempt + 1}: {', '.join(missing)}")
            focus = f"\nStill missing from the views read so far: {', '.join(missing)}. Open the views for these."
        if record is not None and record.material_number != number:
            record.problems.append(f"reader reported material {record.material_number} for {number}")
        return record

    def start(self, req: EffectiveRequirement) -> asyncio.Task:
        """Research one requirement in the background (e.g. as soon as the specification yields it)."""
        if self.started_at is None:
            self.started_at = time.monotonic()
        if req.requirement_id not in self.tasks:
            self.tasks[req.requirement_id] = asyncio.create_task(self.requirement(req))
        return self.tasks[req.requirement_id]

    async def collect(self) -> ErpResearch:
        """Wait for every started requirement and the materials they inspect (each ends by the deadline)."""
        results = []
        for k in sorted(self.tasks, key=calc.position_key):
            try:
                results.append(await self.tasks[k])
            except Exception as error:  # one failed requirement must not cost the others
                results.append(RequirementResearch(requirement_id=k, problems=[
                    f"research failed: {type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:160]}"]))
        return ErpResearch(requirements=results, materials=self.records(),
                           seconds=round(time.monotonic() - (self.started_at or time.monotonic()), 1))

    def records(self) -> dict[str, MaterialRecord]:
        """Every material record finished so far."""
        out = {}
        for number, task in self.materials.items():
            if task.done() and not task.cancelled() and task.exception() is None and task.result() is not None:
                out[number] = task.result()
            elif task.done() and not task.cancelled() and task.exception() is not None:
                self.trace.event("erp", "material_failed", material=number, error=type(task.exception()).__name__)
        return out

    async def research(self, requirements: list[EffectiveRequirement]) -> ErpResearch:
        for req in requirements:
            self.start(req)
        return await self.collect()


class MaterialChoice(BaseModel):

    why: str = Field(description="In a few words")


CHOOSE_MATERIAL = """\

bore, stroke, pressure, mounting and certification must all equal the requirement exactly (numbers as numbers;
no certification required means the material must name none). Blocked materials never qualify. If none
qualifies, answer ''."""

CHOOSE_THINKING = os.environ.get("RESEARCH_CHOOSE_THINKING", "0") == "1"


def _describe(number: str, record: MaterialRecord, research: RequirementResearch) -> str:
    attrs = merged_attributes(record, research)
    shown = ", ".join(f"{k} {attrs[k]}" for k in ("bore", "stroke", "pressure", "mounting", "certification")
                      if k in attrs)
    return f"- {number}: status {record.status}, active={record.active}; {shown}"

        if self.started_at is None:

        """Wait for every started requirement and the materials they inspect (each ends by the deadline)."""
        results = []
        for k in sorted(self.tasks, key=calc.position_key):

        """Every material record finished so far."""

                self.trace.event("erp", "material_failed", material=number, error=type(task.exception()).__name__)
            elif task.result() is not None:
                out[number] = task.result()
        return out

    async def research(self, requirements: list[EffectiveRequirement]) -> ErpResearch:
        for req in requirements:
            self.start(req)
        return await self.collect()


class MaterialChoice(BaseModel):
    material_number: str = Field(description="The chosen material number, or '' if none of them qualifies")
    why: str = Field(description="In a few words")


CHOOSE_MATERIAL = """\
You choose the ERP material for one tender requirement. Only an active (released) material qualifies, and its
bore, stroke, pressure, mounting and certification must all equal the requirement exactly (numbers as numbers;
no certification required means the material must name none). Blocked materials never qualify. If none
qualifies, answer ''."""

# The choice is a short decision over records already read, and `evidence.check_choice` sends a wrong one back with
# the reason, so it runs thinking off with a short timeout (RESEARCH_CHOOSE_THINKING=1 turns thinking on).
CHOOSE_THINKING = os.environ.get("RESEARCH_CHOOSE_THINKING", "0") == "1"


def _describe(number: str, record: MaterialRecord, research: RequirementResearch) -> str:
    attrs = merged_attributes(record, research)
    shown = ", ".join(f"{k} {attrs[k]}" for k in ("bore", "stroke", "pressure", "mounting", "certification")
                      if k in attrs)
    return f"- {number}: status {record.status}, active={record.active}; {shown}"


async def choose_material(req: EffectiveRequirement, research: RequirementResearch,
                          materials: dict[str, MaterialRecord], trace: Trace | None = None
                          ) -> tuple[str | None, list[str]]:
    """The model picks the material from the inspected candidates; `evidence.check_choice` validates the exact
    match and status and sends a wrong choice back with the reason."""
    if req.stroke is None:
        return None, [f"{req.requirement_id}: stroke pending ({'; '.join(req.pending)})"]
    if not materials:
        return None, [f"{req.requirement_id}: no material could be inspected"]
    agent = Agent(llm.model(), output_type=MaterialChoice, instructions=CHOOSE_MATERIAL,
                  model_settings=llm.settings(CHOOSE_THINKING, timeout=llm.env_seconds("LLM_CHOOSE_TIMEOUT", 30.0)),
                  retries=3)

    @agent.output_validator
    def _valid(out: MaterialChoice) -> MaterialChoice:
        problem = check_choice(req, research, materials, out.material_number.strip() or None)
        if problem:
            if trace:
                trace.event("choose", "choice_refused", requirement=req.requirement_id, chose=out.material_number,
                            problem=problem)
            raise ModelRetry(problem)
        return out

    listing = "\n".join(_describe(n, r, research) for n, r in materials.items())
    prompt = f"Requirement {req.requirement_id}: {_want(req)}.\nInspected ERP materials:\n{listing}"
    started = time.monotonic()
    try:
        choice = (await agent.run(prompt)).output
    except Exception as error:
        return None, [f"{req.requirement_id}: no valid choice ({type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:120]})"]
    if trace:
        trace.event("choose", "material", requirement=req.requirement_id, chose=choice.material_number,
                    why=choice.why, seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started, 1))
    return choice.material_number.strip() or None, []


RESELECT_SECONDS = float(os.environ.get("RESELECT_SECONDS", "50"))  # below the orchestrator's own cap


async def reselect(requirements: list[EffectiveRequirement], erp: ErpResearch, trace: Trace | None = None,
                   budget: float = RESELECT_SECONDS) -> dict[str, str | None]:
    """
    Choose again once reserves or amendments have resolved the requirements (the ERP stage inspected every hit,
    so no further browsing is needed). A choice the ERP stage's model made that still passes `check_choice` for the
    final requirement stands without another call; the others are asked in parallel within `budget` seconds. A
    requirement whose choice fails or runs out of time gets None and a problem on its research, so its position is
    left out rather than taken for "no material" (no_bid); the choices made by then are kept.
    """
    by_id = {r.requirement_id: r for r in erp.requirements}
    chosen: dict[str, str | None] = {}
    asked: list[str] = []

    async def one(req: EffectiveRequirement) -> None:
        research = by_id.get(req.requirement_id)
        if research is None:
            return
        materials = {n: erp.materials[n] for n in research.inspected if n in erp.materials}
        if (req.stroke is not None and research.selected in materials
                and check_choice(req, research, materials, research.selected) is None):
            chosen[req.requirement_id] = research.selected
            return
        asked.append(req.requirement_id)
        number, problems = await choose_material(req, research, materials, trace)
        research.problems += [p for p in problems if p not in research.problems]
        chosen[req.requirement_id] = number

    started = time.monotonic()
    tasks = [asyncio.create_task(one(r)) for r in requirements]
    if tasks:
        _, pending = await asyncio.wait(tasks, timeout=budget)
        for task in pending:
            task.cancel()
        await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)
    for req in requirements:
        research = by_id.get(req.requirement_id)
        if research is not None and req.requirement_id not in chosen:
            research.problems.append(f"{req.requirement_id}: final material choice not made in time")
            chosen[req.requirement_id] = None
    if trace:
        trace.event("choose", "reselect", seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started, 1), asked=asked, chosen=chosen)
    return chosen

bore, stroke, pressure, mounting and certification must all equal the requirement exactly (numbers as numbers;

    attrs = merged_attributes(record, research)

async def choose_material(req: EffectiveRequirement, research: RequirementResearch,
                          materials: dict[str, MaterialRecord], trace: Trace | None = None
                          ) -> tuple[str | None, list[str]]:
    """The model picks the material from the inspected candidates; `evidence.check_choice` validates the exact
    match and status and sends a wrong choice back with the reason."""
    if req.stroke is None:
        return None, [f"{req.requirement_id}: stroke pending ({'; '.join(req.pending)})"]
    if not materials:
        return None, [f"{req.requirement_id}: no material could be inspected"]
    agent = Agent(llm.model(), output_type=MaterialChoice, instructions=CHOOSE_MATERIAL,
                  model_settings=llm.settings(CHOOSE_THINKING, timeout=llm.env_seconds("LLM_CHOOSE_TIMEOUT", 30.0)),
                  retries=3)

    def _valid(out: MaterialChoice) -> MaterialChoice:
        problem = check_choice(req, research, materials, out.material_number.strip() or None)
        if problem:
            if trace:
                trace.event("choose", "choice_refused", requirement=req.requirement_id, chose=out.material_number,
                            problem=problem)
            raise ModelRetry(problem)
        return out

    listing = "\n".join(_describe(n, r, research) for n, r in materials.items())
    prompt = f"Requirement {req.requirement_id}: {_want(req)}.\nInspected ERP materials:\n{listing}"
    started = time.monotonic()
    try:
        choice = (await agent.run(prompt)).output
    except Exception as error:
        return None, [f"{req.requirement_id}: no valid choice ({type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:120]})"]
    if trace:
        trace.event("choose", "material", requirement=req.requirement_id, chose=choice.material_number,

async def reselect(requirements: list[EffectiveRequirement], erp: ErpResearch, trace: Trace | None = None,
                   budget: float = RESELECT_SECONDS) -> dict[str, str | None]:
    """
    Choose again once reserves or amendments have resolved the requirements (the ERP stage inspected every hit,
    so no further browsing is needed). A choice the ERP stage's model made that still passes `check_choice` for the
    final requirement stands without another call; the others are asked in parallel within `budget` seconds. A
    requirement whose choice fails or runs out of time gets None and a problem on its research, so its position is
    left out rather than taken for "no material" (no_bid); the choices made by then are kept.
    """
    by_id = {r.requirement_id: r for r in erp.requirements}
    chosen: dict[str, str | None] = {}
    asked: list[str] = []

    async def one(req: EffectiveRequirement) -> None:
        research = by_id.get(req.requirement_id)
        if research is None:
            return
        materials = {n: erp.materials[n] for n in research.inspected if n in erp.materials}
        if (req.stroke is not None and research.selected in materials
                and check_choice(req, research, materials, research.selected) is None):
            chosen[req.requirement_id] = research.selected
            return
        asked.append(req.requirement_id)
        number, problems = await choose_material(req, research, materials, trace)
        research.problems += [p for p in problems if p not in research.problems]
        chosen[req.requirement_id] = number

    started = time.monotonic()
    tasks = [asyncio.create_task(one(r)) for r in requirements]
    if tasks:
        _, pending = await asyncio.wait(tasks, timeout=budget)
        for task in pending:
            task.cancel()
        await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)
    for req in requirements:
        research = by_id.get(req.requirement_id)
        if research is not None and req.requirement_id not in chosen:
            research.problems.append(f"{req.requirement_id}: final material choice not made in time")
            chosen[req.requirement_id] = None
    if trace:
        trace.event("choose", "reselect", seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started, 1), asked=asked, chosen=chosen)
    return chosen

class Erp:
    """
    The ERP website: one signed-in context and a few reused tabs, so requirements and materials run in parallel.

    The ERP drops its session after some idle minutes and when several tabs sign in at once. Sign-ins are therefore
    serialised over the tabs, and a tab that lands somewhere other than the view it asked for (a sign-in, an entry
    gate) gets one model worker past the gate (`recover`, one tab at a time) and opens its view again.
    """

    def __init__(self, site: dict, context: BrowserContext, trace: Trace, deadline: float | None = None):
        self.site, self.context, self.trace, self.deadline = site, context, trace, deadline
        self.ready: asyncio.Task | None = None
        self.materials: dict[str, asyncio.Task] = {}
        self.tasks: dict[str, asyncio.Task] = {}
        # a few tabs at once: every tab is one more page load on a site that slows down under load
        self.tabs = asyncio.Semaphore(int(os.environ.get("ERP_TABS", "6")))
        self.idle_pages: list[Page] = []  # open tabs a finished worker left, reused instead of a fresh start
        self.signin = asyncio.Lock()  # one sign-in at a time
        self.signins = 0
        self.gate = asyncio.Lock()  # one tab gets past an entry gate at a time
        self.passes = 0  # gates passed; a tab that waited for another one's pass just opens its view again
        self.started_at: float | None = None

    def left(self) -> float:
        return float("inf") if self.deadline is None else self.deadline - time.monotonic()

    def _until(self, reserve: float) -> float | None:
        return None if self.deadline is None else self.deadline - reserve

    def warm_up(self) -> asyncio.Task:
        """Sign in and get past entry gates once (a model handles gates the helpers cannot), e.g. while the
        specification is still being read."""
        if self.ready is None:
            self.ready = asyncio.create_task(self._warm_up())
        return self.ready

    async def _warm_up(self) -> None:
        try:
            session = await self._tab("start")
        except Exception as error:  # the workers' own tabs try again
            self.trace.event("erp", "warm_up_failed", error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:160]}")
            return
        try:
            async with self.gate:
                await self._pass_gate(session)
        finally:
            await self._close(session)

    async def _pass_gate(self, session: SiteSession) -> None:
        await run_worker(session, GATE_GOAL, Ready, deadline=self._until(0), max_steps=8,
                         **_worker_kwargs(notes=False, grounded=False))
        self.passes += 1

    async def recover(self, session: SiteSession) -> None:
        """The tab did not reach its view (session dropped, entry gate): get past the gate once for all tabs."""
        passes = self.passes
        async with self.gate:
            if self.passes != passes:  # another tab passed the gate while this one waited
                return
            self.trace.event(session.name, "erp_recover", url=session.page.url)
            await self._pass_gate(session)

        """Sign-ins one tab at a time; a tab that waited while another signed in first reloads, since the shared
        context may already be signed in again."""
        login = session._login

        async def serialised(page: Page) -> bool:
            if not await page.locator("input[type=password]:visible").count():
                return False
            signins = self.signins

                if self.signins != signins:
                    try:
                        await page.reload(wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=30000)
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                    if not await page.locator("input[type=password]:visible").count():

                done = await login(page)

        self._guard_login(session)

        while self.idle_pages and page is None:

        return session

        that lands elsewhere (sign-in, entry gate) recovers once and opens it again."""

        problem = check_choice(req, research, materials, out.material_number.strip() or None)
        if problem:
            if trace:
                trace.event("choose", "choice_refused", requirement=req.requirement_id, chose=out.material_number,
                            problem=problem)
            raise ModelRetry(problem)
        return out

    listing = "\n".join(_describe(n, r, research) for n, r in materials.items())
    prompt = f"Requirement {req.requirement_id}: {_want(req)}.\nInspected ERP materials:\n{listing}"
    started = time.monotonic()
    try:
        choice = (await agent.run(prompt)).output
    except Exception as error:
        return None, [f"{req.requirement_id}: no valid choice ({type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:120]})"]
    if trace:
        trace.event("choose", "material", requirement=req.requirement_id, chose=choice.material_number,
                    why=choice.why, seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started, 1))
    return choice.material_number.strip() or None, []


RESELECT_SECONDS = float(os.environ.get("RESELECT_SECONDS", "50"))  # below the orchestrator's own cap


async def reselect(requirements: list[EffectiveRequirement], erp: ErpResearch, trace: Trace | None = None,
                   budget: float = RESELECT_SECONDS) -> dict[str, str | None]:
    """
    Choose again once reserves or amendments have resolved the requirements (the ERP stage inspected every hit,
    so no further browsing is needed). A choice the ERP stage's model made that still passes `check_choice` for the
    final requirement stands without another call; the others are asked in parallel within `budget` seconds. A
    requirement whose choice fails or runs out of time gets None and a problem on its research, so its position is
    left out rather than taken for "no material" (no_bid); the choices made by then are kept.
    """
    by_id = {r.requirement_id: r for r in erp.requirements}
    chosen: dict[str, str | None] = {}
    asked: list[str] = []

    async def one(req: EffectiveRequirement) -> None:
        research = by_id.get(req.requirement_id)
        if research is None:
            return
        materials = {n: erp.materials[n] for n in research.inspected if n in erp.materials}
        if (req.stroke is not None and research.selected in materials
                and check_choice(req, research, materials, research.selected) is None):
            chosen[req.requirement_id] = research.selected
            return
        asked.append(req.requirement_id)
        number, problems = await choose_material(req, research, materials, trace)
        research.problems += [p for p in problems if p not in research.problems]
        chosen[req.requirement_id] = number

    started = time.monotonic()
    tasks = [asyncio.create_task(one(r)) for r in requirements]
    if tasks:
        _, pending = await asyncio.wait(tasks, timeout=budget)
        for task in pending:
            task.cancel()
        await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)
    for req in requirements:
        research = by_id.get(req.requirement_id)
        if research is not None and req.requirement_id not in chosen:
            research.problems.append(f"{req.requirement_id}: final material choice not made in time")
            chosen[req.requirement_id] = None
    if trace:
        trace.event("choose", "reselect", seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started, 1), asked=asked, chosen=chosen)
    return chosen

class Requirement(BaseModel):
    """One requirement of the governing specification revision, parsed."""
    requirement_id: str
    revision: str
    bore: Decimal
    stroke: Decimal = Field(description="As written; the usable travel when stroke_is_usable is set")
    pressure: Decimal
    mounting: str
    certification: str
    catalog_group: str
    pieces_per_set: int | None = None
    stroke_is_usable: bool = False
    reserve_key: str | None = None
    raw: dict[str, str] = Field(default_factory=dict, description="The values as the page showed them")


class SpecResult(BaseModel):
    document: str = ""
    revisions: list[SpecRevision] = Field(default_factory=list)
    current_revision: str = ""
    requirements: list[Requirement] = Field(default_factory=list)
    problems: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    seconds: float = 0


class EffectiveRequirement(BaseModel):
    """The attributes an ERP material must match, after amendments and the usable-travel derivation (rules 14, 20)."""
    requirement_id: str
    catalog_group: str
    bore: Decimal
    stroke: Decimal | None = Field(description="Nominal stroke to match; None while a usable-travel reserve is "
                                               "still unknown")
    pressure: Decimal
    mounting: str
    certification: str
    pending: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="What is still unresolved")

    def attributes(self) -> dict[str, Decimal | str]:
        attrs: dict[str, Decimal | str] = {"bore": self.bore, "pressure": self.pressure,
                                           "mounting": norm_text(self.mounting),
                                           "certification": norm_text(self.certification)}
        if self.stroke is not None:
            attrs["stroke"] = self.stroke
        return attrs


def effective_requirement(req: Requirement, amendments: list[calc.Amendment] | None = None,
                          reserves: dict[str, Decimal] | None = None,
                          scenario_date: date | datetime | None = None) -> EffectiveRequirement:
    """
    Hooks for the other workers' facts: scoped amendments from the tender Q&A (already filtered to the right sender
    by the caller; revision and requirement scoping and latest-wins happen here) and the per-end reserve values of
    the revision-specific Technikfreigabe, by reserve key. Without a needed reserve the stroke stays open.
    """
    base: dict[str, Decimal | str] = {"bore": req.bore, "stroke": req.stroke, "pressure": req.pressure,
                                      "mounting": req.mounting, "certification": req.certification}
    attrs = calc.apply_amendments(base, amendments or [], req.revision, req.requirement_id, scenario_date)
    pending: list[str] = []
    stroke: Decimal | None = Decimal(str(attrs["stroke"]))
    if req.stroke_is_usable:
        reserve = (reserves or {}).get(req.reserve_key or "")
        if reserve is None:
            pending.append(f"per-end reserve for key {req.reserve_key or '(none given)'}")
            stroke = None
        else:
            stroke = calc.nominal_stroke(stroke, Decimal(str(reserve)))
    return EffectiveRequirement(requirement_id=req.requirement_id, catalog_group=req.catalog_group,
                                bore=Decimal(str(attrs["bore"])), stroke=stroke,
                                pressure=Decimal(str(attrs["pressure"])), mounting=str(attrs["mounting"]),
                                certification=str(attrs["certification"]), pending=pending)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- ERP


class Candidate(BaseModel):
    """A search hit with the attributes the list (or its detail page) shows."""
    material_number: str
    link: str = ""
    bore: Decimal | None = None
    stroke: Decimal | None = None
    pressure: Decimal | None = None
    mounting: str = ""
    certification: str = ""
    description: str = ""

    def attributes(self) -> dict[str, Decimal | str]:
        attrs: dict[str, Decimal | str] = {"mounting": norm_text(self.mounting),
                                           "certification": norm_text(self.certification)}
        for key in ("bore", "stroke", "pressure"):
            if getattr(self, key) is not None:
                attrs[key] = getattr(self, key)
        return attrs


def matches(req: EffectiveRequirement, attrs: dict[str, Decimal | str]) -> bool:
    """Rule 3 as a validator: every resolved attribute equal (numbers as numbers, texts normalised)."""
    want = req.attributes()
    return bool(calc.matching_materials(want, [("x", attrs)], keys=tuple(want)))


class MaterialRecord(BaseModel):
    """Everything the ERP shows for one material that the bid needs, parsed."""
    material_number: str
    active: bool
    status: str = ""
    bore: Decimal | None = None
    stroke: Decimal | None = None
    pressure: Decimal | None = None
    mounting: str = ""
    certification: str = ""
    free_stock: int | None = None
    blocked_stock: int | None = None
    stock_lead_time_weeks: int | None = None
    production_lead_time_weeks: int | None = None
    pieces_per_carton: int | None = None
    allocation_mass_kg: Decimal | None = None
    surcharge_mass_kg: Decimal | None = None
    metal_index: str | None = None
    conditions: list[calc.PriceCondition] = Field(default_factory=list)
    raw: dict = Field(default_factory=dict)
    problems: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)

    def attributes(self) -> dict[str, Decimal | str]:
        return Candidate(material_number=self.material_number, bore=self.bore, stroke=self.stroke,
                         pressure=self.pressure, mounting=self.mounting,
                         certification=self.certification).attributes()

    def to_material(self) -> calc.Material:
        missing = [k for k in ("stock_lead_time_weeks", "production_lead_time_weeks") if getattr(self, k) is None]
        if missing:
            raise calc.CalcError(f"{self.material_number}: {', '.join(missing)} unknown")
        return calc.Material(material_number=self.material_number, free_stock=self.free_stock or 0,
                             stock_lead_time_weeks=self.stock_lead_time_weeks,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                             production_lead_time_weeks=self.production_lead_time_weeks,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                             pieces_per_carton=self.pieces_per_carton,
                             allocation_mass=self.allocation_mass_kg or Decimal(0),
                             surcharge_mass=self.surcharge_mass_kg or Decimal(0), metal_index=self.metal_index)


class RequirementResearch(BaseModel):
    """ERP findings for one requirement: what was searched, the candidates, and the matching active material."""
    requirement_id: str
    search_term: str = ""
    candidates: list[Candidate] = Field(default_factory=list)
    inspected: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    selected: str | None = Field(default=None, description="The exactly matching active material, if any")
    problems: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


def merged_attributes(record: MaterialRecord, research: RequirementResearch) -> dict[str, Decimal | str]:
    """A material's attributes: the detail page's where it showed them, else the search list's."""
    cand = next((c for c in research.candidates if c.material_number == record.material_number), None)
    attrs = cand.attributes() if cand else {}
    for key in ("bore", "stroke", "pressure"):
        if getattr(record, key) is not None:
            attrs[key] = getattr(record, key)

"""reselect(): earlier valid choices stand without a model call, and a slow choice never discards the others."""
import asyncio
import sys
import unittest
from decimal import Decimal as D
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

import research  # noqa: E402
from evidence import EffectiveRequirement, MaterialRecord, RequirementResearch  # noqa: E402


def req(rid: str, stroke: str | None = "100") -> EffectiveRequirement:
    return EffectiveRequirement(requirement_id=rid, catalog_group="GR-1", bore=D("50"),
                                stroke=D(stroke) if stroke else None, pressure=D("200"), mounting="Flansch",
                                certification="keine", pending=[] if stroke else ["reserve"])


def record(number: str, stroke: str, active: bool = True) -> MaterialRecord:
    return MaterialRecord(material_number=number, active=active, status="01", bore=D("50"), stroke=D(stroke),
                          pressure=D("200"), mounting="Flansch", certification="keine")


class ReselectTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.original = research.choose_material
        self.asked: list[str] = []

    def tearDown(self):
        research.choose_material = self.original

    def erp(self) -> research.ErpResearch:
        return research.ErpResearch(
            requirements=[RequirementResearch(requirement_id="A-1", inspected=["M-1", "M-2"], selected="M-1"),
                          RequirementResearch(requirement_id="A-2", inspected=["M-3"], selected=None,
                                              problems=["A-2: stroke pending (reserve)"]),
                          RequirementResearch(requirement_id="A-3", inspected=["M-4"], selected=None)],
            materials={"M-1": record("M-1", "100"), "M-2": record("M-2", "120"), "M-3": record("M-3", "130"),
                       "M-4": record("M-4", "100")})

    def test_valid_choice_stands_and_slow_choice_is_bounded(self):
        async def fake(req, research_, materials, trace=None):
            self.asked.append(req.requirement_id)
            if req.requirement_id == "A-3":
                await asyncio.sleep(5)  # a hung model call
            return "M-3", []

        research.choose_material = fake

The ERP drops its session after some idle minutes and when several tabs sign in at once. Sign-ins are therefore
    serialised over the tabs, and a tab that lands somewhere other than the view it asked for (a sign-in, an entry
    gate) gets one model worker past the gate (`recover`, one tab at a time) and opens its view again.
    """

    def __init__(self, site: dict, context: BrowserContext, trace: Trace, deadline: float | None = None):
        self.site, self.context, self.trace, self.deadline = site, context, trace, deadline
        self.ready: asyncio.Task | None = None
        self.materials: dict[str, asyncio.Task] = {}
        self.tasks: dict[str, asyncio.Task] = {}
        # a few tabs at once: every tab is one more page load on a site that slows down under load
        self.tabs = asyncio.Semaphore(int(os.environ.get("ERP_TABS", "6")))
        self.idle_pages: list[Page] = []  # open tabs a finished worker left, reused instead of a fresh start
        self.signin = asyncio.Lock()  # one sign-in at a time
        self.signins = 0
        self.gate = asyncio.Lock()  # one tab gets past an entry gate at a time
        self.passes = 0  # gates passed; a tab that waited for another one's pass just opens its view again
        self.started_at: float | None = None

    def left(self) -> float:
        return float("inf") if self.deadline is None else self.deadline - time.monotonic()

    def _until(self, reserve: float) -> float | None:
        return None if self.deadline is None else self.deadline - reserve

    def warm_up(self) -> asyncio.Task:
        """Sign in and get past entry gates once (a model handles gates the helpers cannot), e.g. while the
        specification is still being read."""
        if self.ready is None:
            self.ready = asyncio.create_task(self._warm_up())
        return self.ready

    async def _warm_up(self) -> None:
        try:
            session = await self._tab("start")
        except Exception as error:  # the workers' own tabs try again
            self.trace.event("erp", "warm_up_failed", error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:160]}")
            return
        try:
            async with self.gate:
                await self._pass_gate(session)
        finally:
            await self._close(session)

    async def _pass_gate(self, session: SiteSession) -> None:
        await run_worker(session, GATE_GOAL, Ready, deadline=self._until(0), max_steps=8,
                         **_worker_kwargs(notes=False, grounded=False))
        self.passes += 1

    async def recover(self, session: SiteSession) -> None:
        """The tab did not reach its view (session dropped, entry gate): get past the gate once for all tabs."""
        passes = self.passes
        async with self.gate:
            if self.passes != passes:  # another tab passed the gate while this one waited
                return
            self.trace.event(session.name, "erp_recover", url=session.page.url)
            await self._pass_gate(session)

    def _guard_login(self, session: SiteSession) -> None:
        """Sign-ins one tab at a time; a tab that waited while another signed in first reloads, since the shared
        context may already be signed in again."""
        login = session._login

            if not await page.locator("input[type=password]:visible").count():
                return False
            signins = self.signins
            async with self.signin:
                if self.signins != signins:
                    try:
                        await page.reload(wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=30000)
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                    if not await page.locator("input[type=password]:visible").count():
                        session.events.append("another tab signed in; reloaded")
                        return True
                done = await login(page)
                if done:
                    self.signins += 1
                    await asyncio.sleep(1.0)  # let the sign-in land before the next tab acts
                return done

        session._login = serialised  # type: ignore[method-assign]

    async def _tab(self, tag: str, url: str | None = None) -> SiteSession:
        """A tab in the shared context (a reused one when a finished worker left it); `tag` names it in the
        trace. With `url`, the tab opens that link target."""
        session = SiteSession({**self.site, "siteId": f"{self.site['siteId']}:{tag}"}, self.context, self.trace)
        self._guard_login(session)

elif "mails" in sites:
            self.board.problem("plan", "mail research module not available")
        if not jobs:
            return
        done, pending = await asyncio.wait(jobs, timeout=max(1.0, self.left()))
        for job in pending:  # the deadline guard: whatever is complete goes on
            job.cancel()
            self.board.problem("deadline", f"{job.get_name()} stopped at the research deadline")
        if pending:
            await asyncio.gather(*pending, return_exceptions=True)
        if self._erp is not None:  # ERP workers still browsing would compete with the bid form for the browser
            for task in [*self._erp.tasks.values(), *self._erp.materials.values()]:
                if not task.done():
                    task.cancel()
            if self.erp is None:  # stopped at the deadline: what finished still counts
                so_far = getattr(self._erp, "so_far", None)
                self.erp = so_far() if so_far is not None else self._finished_erp()
        self.rework = {"mails": self._rework_mail}

    def _finished_erp(self) -> ErpResearch:
        def finished(tasks):
            return {k: t.result() for k, t in tasks.items()
                    if t.done() and not t.cancelled() and t.exception() is None and t.result() is not None}
        return ErpResearch(requirements=list(finished(self._erp.tasks).values()),
                           materials=finished(self._erp.materials))

    async def _rework_mail(self, doubtful: list) -> None:
        names = {f.key.split("/")[0] for f in doubtful}
        kinds = [k for k in self.mail_kinds if k.name in names]
        if kinds and self.mail_sessions:
            await self._research_mail(kinds, min(self.research_deadline, time.monotonic() + REWORK_SECONDS))

    async def verify(self) -> None:
        doubtful = await verify_board(self.board, self.rules, self.reference, self.briefing.scenario_date)
        by_worker: dict[str, list] = {}
        for fact in doubtful:
            by_worker.setdefault(fact.worker, []).append(fact)
        for worker, facts in by_worker.items():
            rework = self.rework.get(worker)
            if rework is None or self.left() < REWORK_SECONDS:
                continue
            self.trace.event("verify", "rework", by=worker, facts=[f.ident for f in facts])
            try:
                await asyncio.wait_for(rework(facts), max(1.0, self.left()))
            except Exception as error:
                self.board.problem("verify", f"rework {worker}: {type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:160]}")
        if by_worker:
            await verify_board(self.board, self.rules, self.reference, self.briefing.scenario_date)

    async def select_materials(self) -> None:
        """The final material choice, once amendments and reserves are on the board (reselect: no browsing)."""
        if self.erp is None or not self.requirements:
            return
        effective = [self.effective(req) for req in self.requirements.values()]
        own = {r.requirement_id: r.selected for r in self.erp.requirements}
        # One choice per requirement, side by side: one hung model call must not cost the others; choices not made
        # in time are the ERP workers' own.
        tasks = {req.requirement_id: asyncio.create_task(reselect([req], self.erp, self.trace)) for req in effective}
        _, late_tasks = await asyncio.wait(tasks.values(), timeout=SELECT_SECONDS)
        for task in late_tasks:
            task.cancel()
        if late_tasks:
            await asyncio.gather(*late_tasks, return_exceptions=True)
        chosen = {}
        for rid, task in tasks.items():
            if task.done() and not task.cancelled() and task.exception() is None:
                chosen.update(task.result())
        late = sorted(set(own) - set(chosen))
        if late:
            self.board.problem("select", f"no new choice in time for {late}; the ERP workers' choices are used")
        self.chosen = {**own, **chosen}
        self.trace.event("select", "done", chosen=self.chosen)

    def _unknown_clauses(self, p, clause, pool, bonus) -> None:
        """A position whose Q&A names a key the mails did not resolve: calc would report a zero for that part,
        which reads as a known zero, so the report field and the unit price it feeds are left blank instead."""
        fields = set()
        if getattr(p, "packaging_key", None) and getattr(clause, "packaging", None) is None:
            fields |= {"packaging_per_unit", "unit_price"}
        if getattr(p, "setup_pool_key", None) and p.position not in getattr(pool, "members", []):
            fields |= {"surcharge_per_unit", "unit_price"}

import asyncio
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd() / "agent"))
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright  # noqa: E402

import browsers  # noqa: E402
import run as contract  # noqa: E402
import site_tools  # noqa: E402
from research import Erp  # noqa: E402
from tracing import Trace  # noqa: E402


async def main():
    task, _ = contract.load_run()
    site = next(s for s in task["access"] if "erp" in s["siteId"])
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        (ctx,) = await browsers.contexts(p, 1)
        erp = Erp(site, ctx, Trace())
        await erp.warm_up()
        s = await erp._tab("probe", "/search?transaction=MM03")
        for q in sys.argv[1:]:
            await s.look()
            field = re.search(r"\[(e\d+) textbox \"Bezeichnung", s.view).group(1)
            button = re.search(r"\[(e\d+) button \"Suchen", s.view).group(1)
            print("=====", q)
            print(await site_tools.run_search(s, field, q, button))


asyncio.run(main())
